hooks.command:
set -euo pipefail
payload="$(cat)"
if [ "${CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION:-}" = "1" ]; then
    exit 0
fi

tool="$(jq -r '.tool_name // empty' <<<"$payload")"
file_path="$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' <<<"$payload")"
command_text="$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' <<<"$payload")"

is_global_claude_settings_path() {
    local path="$1"
    case "$path" in
        "$HOME/.claude" | "$HOME/.claude/"* | ~/.claude | ~/.claude/*)
            return 0
            ;;
    esac
    return 1
}

is_inside_git_repo() {
    local target="${1:-}"
    local dir
    if [ -z "$target" ]; then
        git rev-parse --show-toplevel >/dev/null 2>&1
        return
    fi
    if [ -d "$target" ]; then
        dir="$target"
    else
        dir="$(dirname "$target")"
    fi
    [ -d "$dir" ] || return 1
    git -C "$dir" rev-parse --show-toplevel >/dev/null 2>&1
}

is_read_only_bash() {
    local command="$1"
    command="${command#"${command%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    command="${command%"${command##*[![:space:]]}"}"
    if [[ "$command" == *";"* || "$command" == *"&&"* || "$command" == *"||"* || "$command" == *"|"* || "$command" == *">"* || "$command" == *"<"* || "$command" == *" --output"* || "$command" == *'`'* || "$command" == *'$('* ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    case "$command" in
        "" | ":" | "true" | "pwd" | "ls" | ls\ * | rg\ * | grep\ * | jq\ * | test\ * | git\ status* | git\ diff* | git\ log* | git\ show* | git\ rev-parse* | git\ ls-files* | git\ grep* | gh\ auth\ status* | gh\ api\ user* | gh\ pr\ view* | gh\ pr\ checks* | gh\ issue\ view* | gh\ run\ view*)
            return 0
            ;;
    esac
    return 1
}

ask_for_main_session_confirmation() {
    local reason="This operation may modify files inside a git repository from the main session. Prefer delegating implementation to an agent team. Approve only if the main session should proceed directly."
    jq -n --arg reason "$reason" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":$reason}}'
}

case "$tool" in
    Edit | Write | MultiEdit)
        if is_global_claude_settings_path "$file_path"; then
            exit 0
        fi
        if is_inside_git_repo "$file_path"; then
            ask_for_main_session_confirmation
        fi
        ;;
    Bash)
        if is_inside_git_repo "" && ! is_read_only_bash "$command_text"; then
            ask_for_main_session_confirmation
        fi
        ;;
esac
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path | select(endswith(".py"))' | xargs -r uvx ruff format
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path | select(endswith(".py"))' | xargs -r uvx ruff check --fix
